outcome: Hospital admissions for infections (total, respiratory, gastrointestinal, multisystem viral infections)
cohort: The study included 9540 singleton births between 2007 and 2011 to 9037 mothers from the Born in Bradford multi-ethnic birth cohort.
finding: Maternal obesity (grades 2-3) was significantly associated with an increased rate of hospital admissions for infection in offspring throughout childhood, up to age 15 years.
mod_finding: Being born by caesarean section accounted for 21% of the association between maternal obesity and hospital admissions for infection.
